problems.title: Formalize Schur's partition theorem

feasibility.rationale: Classic partition theorem with known proofs. Mathlib gap identified. Excellent formalization target: well-understood mathematics, existing proof techniques, good infrastructure in Mathlib. Partial progress = incremental formalization steps. Zero crackpot risk (established 1926 theorem). Recommendation: formalize-only (not original research, but valuable Mathlib contribution).

problems.notes: Mathlib currently lacks Schur's partition theorem - classic result suitable for formalization

problems.title: Graceful labeling verification for small caterpillar trees

feasibility.rationale: Finite enumeration + backtracking search for caterpillar trees ≤12 vertices (~400 trees). Known partial results (n≤8 confirmed). Clear success/failure criteria. Strong partial progress (results partition by n). Low crackpot risk (bounded verification, not claiming to solve full conjecture). Attack-ready with graph theory + CSP skill pack.

problems.notes: Finite check: verify graceful labeling conjecture for caterpillar trees with ≤12 vertices
